content:
The upper semicircle measures \(180^\circ\). Its unshaded angles are \(40^\circ\), \(50^\circ\), and \(30^\circ\), so the shaded sector has central angle

\[
180^\circ-(40^\circ+50^\circ+30^\circ)=60^\circ.
\]

For a point chosen uniformly from the disk,

\[
P=\frac{\text{shaded sector area}}{\text{disk area}}
=\frac{\frac{60^\circ}{360^\circ}\pi r^2}{\pi r^2}
=\frac{60}{360}
=\boxed{\frac16}.
\]
